research_question: After removing known textual dependence, plausible historical contact, translation artifacts, genre effects and expected human/ecological convergence, what recurring structures remain genuinely unresolved?
non_goal: This protocol does not rank religions, select a true canon, infer revelation from similarity, or treat sacred status as empirical authority.

subtract: recensions descending from the same textual ancestor where known
later quotations or retellings of earlier texts
multiple web editions descending from one edition/collector
similarity created by one modern translation language
false equivalence caused by broad glosses
token overlap absent in original-language or philologically controlled alignment
plausible trade, conquest, migration, diaspora or scholarly contact
subtraction_pipeline.rule: absence of a documented route lowers confidence in diffusion but does not prove isolation

subtract: generic responses to death, birth, kinship, reciprocity and social coordination
shared ecological pressures such as flood, drought, fire, famine, disease and seasonality
common narrative grammar such as hero, warning, transgression, punishment, restoration
genre conventions shared by law, hymn, ritual, apocalypse, wisdom and myth

test: shared error or anomaly where philologically defensible

attack_routes: replace rare feature with broader coding and see whether effect vanishes
remove one tradition at a time

residual_states.meaning: known or strongly supported transmission/contact explains recurrence
independent recurrence is plausible but unsurprising under shared human/ecological constraints
data cannot currently separate transmission from independent convergence
rare structure survives current dependence, contact, translation, convergence and blind-control attacks; requires another spiral, not metaphysical promotion
pattern disappears under controls or depends on analyst choices

minimum_evidence_packet_per_claim: feature encoding frozen before label reveal

janus_roles.HRain: build source, chronology, geography and dependency graph
janus_roles.iNaiHR: propose semantic correspondences; zero authority until textual verification
janus_roles.Demi_Head: collapse source roots and preserve contradictory readings
janus_roles.Janus_Genesis: freeze protocol, features and promotion ceilings before analysis
janus_roles.Janus-Fundamentum: generate strongest mundane and historical falsifiers
janus_roles.Fast-CAT-SHAiTan: blind review of encoded feature bundles
janus_roles.AIFC: canonicalize evidence packets, hashes and witness/source identity
janus_roles.Janus-Cosmos: audit pseudoreplication, nulls and control leakage
janus_roles.janus-distributed-ai-swarm: parallelize extraction without multiplying evidence weight
janus_roles.tranception: reverse-trace late forms toward earlier attestations
janus_roles.janus-lapis: freeze only survivors and negative certificates
janus_roles.aura-oracle-tg: hypothesis generator only; evidence authority zero

spiral_rule: Every survivor must be re-entered at R0 with new sources, stronger controls or a new falsifier. A survivor is a question of higher resolution, not a conclusion of higher certainty.
